reviewerType: model qualitative source inspection; no human taste evaluation
scope: Bounded readable passages, not the entire works, corpus, or a human-rated style benchmark.

sources.title: ブロント語改変集・寺生まれのBさん
sources.inspected: Parts 1–2, including opening self-description, the causal/contrast sequence at the end of part 1, and the concluding comparison of part 2.
sources.observation: The narrator places events inside self-serving explanation and comparison, often presenting an evaluation after several reasons. Modest self-presentation sits beside accounts of ability. This is discourse organization and stance as well as recognizable phrases.

sources.title: 謎の改変物
sources.inspected: カサブロント opening; 矛盾; ボダブレ; 方丈記 variants 1–2.
sources.observation: The examples intertwine claims, reasons, contrast and self-positioning. The two 方丈記 variants show that changing vocabulary and reframing a story are different operations. Some reframing invents narrative material; a faithful rewrite must not imitate that factual freedom.

accessLimitations: https://syosetu.org/novel/107412/12.html returned an inaccessible-page error twice in this pass. The prior evaluation's account of it is historical context only, not newly verified evidence.
oii.html contains mojibake in some other sections. No conclusion relies on unreadable text.
comparisonDimensions: Local phrase and ending changes versus source-grounded relations between clauses
Explicit premise, reason, contrast and conclusion progression
Modesty juxtaposed with an achievement already present in the source
Preservation of actors, events, quantities, negation, uncertainty, attribution and quoted text
Residual distance from sustained narrative voice, contextual humor and individual reader taste
evaluationBoundary: Counting constructions or passed verification cannot establish naturalness, humor, preference, or equivalence to these works. S/Q remain untrained and null. Reusing previous ordinary cases is a regression comparison, not a fresh held-out generalization benchmark.
